text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
Yesterday's grand sumo tournament was amazing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That struggle on the edge of the ring... I'm sure we can apply that to our races...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
For that sake... I need to review
the recordings thoroughly again tonight...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right... I should also watch... the bouts
my father... recorded... in the past...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sakura Chiyono O
hasn't been getting enough rest...
